marketValuationOpportunity.note: Current IR quote around $161 plus diversified targets offers plausible upside but requires substantial execution.

catalystScore.note: Amazon AI-data-center collaboration, data-center ramp, automotive pipeline and edge-AI roadmap are multiple identifiable catalysts.

crossDivisionLeverage.note: Common compute/connectivity/IP spans handsets, automotive, IoT, robotics, PCs and data centers.

thesis: Qualcomm can reuse differentiated low-power compute, connectivity and IP across edge, automotive, robotics and data-center markets.
keyRisk: In-house silicon, supply constraints and failure to convert data-center/automotive targets could leave handset concentration dominant.
nextCatalyst: Initial revenue evidence from Amazon/custom-silicon data-center collaboration and acceleration of non-handset revenue into FY27.
